look: Cragling Ogre, a D-rank GKOM variant from the Crag Trolls family: dim hungry ogre carrying half a tree as a club. Family anatomy: huge stooped ogres and trolls with craggy rock-like skin and crude clubs. Build: large, heavy and imposing. GKOM rank cue: GKOM crystals crust its joints and run along the spine; about a quarter of the body crystallised; the crystals are iron-grey crag crystal. A tennis-ball-sized GKOM core orb, dark amber with visible cracks, is embedded visibly in its chest or body centre. Element Earth: amber, moss green and slate accents, modest stone shards, crystal dust and drifting petals
